heading: PFAS destruction and disposal guidance

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than 1 year after December 20, 2019, the Administrator shall publish interim guidance on the destruction and disposal of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances and materials containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, including—

children.text: textiles, other than consumer goods, treated with perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances;
spent filters, membranes, resins, granular carbon, and other waste from water treatment;
landfill leachate containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; and
solid, liquid, or gas waste streams containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances from facilities manufacturing or using perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

tree.heading: Considerations; inclusions
tree.text: The interim guidance under subsection (a) shall—

children.text: the potential for releases of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances during destruction or disposal, including through volatilization, air dispersion, or leachate; and
potentially vulnerable populations living near likely destruction or disposal sites; and
provide guidance on testing and monitoring air, effluent, and soil near potential destruction or disposal sites for releases described in paragraph (1)(A).

tree.heading: Revisions
tree.text: The Administrator shall publish revisions to the interim guidance under subsection (a) as the Administrator determines to be appropriate, but not less frequently than once every 3 years.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 116–92, div. F, title LXXIII, § 7361, Dec. 20, 2019, 133 Stat. 2289.)
